liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **High Time** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the first seven notes of Jerry's solo as shockingly brilliant; Reviewer calls this version tear-jerking [24][27]
- **She Belongs To Me** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer hears Garcia diving deep into this Dylan song, finding beautiful, creative, moving playing; Cut short on this transfer, missing roughly 30 seconds [2][26]
- **Gloria** (2 other sources): Has a minor glitch at the start from a tape change; someone can be heard shouting no; Clips in on this transfer, missing about 20 seconds because of a tape change [1][2]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Phil's bass bombs in this song are highlighted as reason enough to own the recording [23]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 other source): This transfer has a cut at the tape flip, clipping back in around 1:41 [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **She Belongs To Me**: rare: 10 archived performances [31]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-01.cpb.retransfer.32709.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd85-11-01.sbd.mccloskey.379.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 154 min; rated 2.67/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the noise reduction on this soundboard transfer extremely heavy-handed and poor [20]
- **gd85-11-01.aud-oade.remaster.20416.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 159 min; rated 4.59/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Attendee found the audience recording sounded full and powerful; Reviewer stood near the taper section and says the tape matches the floor sound very accurately; Reviewer calls it a great-sounding audience tape that conveys the night's excitement [22][23][25]
- **gd1985-11-01.168186.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd85-11-01.oade.connor.9217.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 4.45/5 by 40 [7]. Said about its sound: Taper-reviewer calls this the best audience recording they have heard [19]

## Around the show

- Attendee describes heavy, out-of-control police presence, but says staying inconspicuous made for a great night [22]
- Cold, rainy night with twice as many people as tickets; many gatecrashed, and vending was huge [28]
- Someone tossed dishwashing detergent into the fountain, producing a mountain of suds [28]
- Reviewer says this audience tape sounds better than the Dick's Picks release of the show [19]
- Reviewer says better soundboard sources of this show exist, having heard them on cassette [20]
- Attendee liked the following night's show even more than this one [22]
- Reviewer ranks it among Jerry's best vocal nights, an outstanding show in an otherwise ordinary year [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-01.cpb.retransfer.32709.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Charles Bandrofcheck; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Can't remember shotgun mics -> Sony D6 -> Maxel MX 90s. As close as they'd let you get to the left of SBD [1]. Also: Cassette recording: side A of tape one, then tape two, then B sides after the break, with no rewinding mid-show [1]
- **gd85-11-01.sbd.mccloskey.379.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard> ?> DAT> CDr [3]. Also: Soundboard source copied through DAT and CDr, then converted to SHN; shared via Stewart McCloskey [3]
- **gd85-11-01.aud-oade.remaster.20416.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) with single Omni center channel mic (CMC42 offset ~ 8' - mixed into main pair of CMC 441s) > custom mixer made by Doug Oade (M118… [4]
- **gd1985-11-01.168186.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [5]
- **gd85-11-01.oade.connor.9217.sbeok.shnf**: source: Oade DFOB -- Schoeps CMC441 (spaced 17cm@90deg) + CMC42 (Spread 8')> Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1 > DAT (@44.1k) [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Poster Richmond 1985, Rare | #2017340712](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-poster-richmond-1985-2017340712) [32]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1985-11-01 Richmond Coliseum, Richmond, VA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-11-01-richmond-coliseum-richmond-va-usa/) [33]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1985-11-01 Fri Richmond Coliseum, Richmond, VA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1423910229959/grateful-dead-1985-11-01-fri-richmond) [34]
